concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-split-transactions]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace transaction-split guide for payment/capture/refund arrays, chargeback logic, split-type fields and liable-account fallback.
warnings: No split profile/API instructions sends whole amount and fees to the liable balance account; a missing account on an individual split also falls back there, subject to required fields. Capture-time splitting requires a payment method supporting separate captures. Instructions are not settlement/payout proof.
